abstract: Welcome to the midpoint of 2023. The first part of the year has been filled with change in our industry and Society. With print deadlines looming, I sit writing this column amid the Writers Guild strike. If ever there was a reminder that the engineering and science we do is in support of an art form, this would be it. Our film and broadcast production departments depend on these artists, so hopefully a resolution can be found soon, even before you read these words.
